proofs.text: Run a suite holding no proof marker and verify the run exits zero and `.purlin/runtime/proofs/` holds no file, in `dev/test_multilang_proof_plugins.py`

rule_text: A run that collected no proof marker writes no proof file and exits zero, so a suite that has nothing to say about a spec says nothing

tests.body:
def test_no_markers_no_proof_files(tmp_path):
    """A run that collected no marker writes nothing at all."""
    root = _project(tmp_path)
    _run_pytest_with_plugin(root, """
        def test_plain():
            assert 1 == 1
    """)
    assert _proof_files(root) == []
tests.name: test_no_markers_no_proof_files
